video_title: 24 Hours With The Best Guard In The Draft (Darius Acuff)

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on his versatile offensive skill set
quotes.excerpt: My greatest strength on the court is my ability to do different things on offense.
quotes.quote: My greatest strength on the court is my ability to do different things on offense. I might have 30 points, I might have 13 assists, I might do both in the same game.

quotes.speaker: Packie Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Packie Turner on Darius Acuff's elite collegiate efficiency
quotes.excerpt: Darius is a highly value prospect right now because he had one of the best collegiate careers.
quotes.quote: Darius is a highly value prospect right now because he had one of the best collegiate careers in the last 30 years this season. It is really hard to find holes in his game right now because at the collegiate level he was so efficient. He does not turn the ball over and for how high his usage rate was, that is just an extremely valuable trait.

quotes.speaker: Nick Potter
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Potter on the importance of core strength for Darius Acuff
quotes.excerpt: At Darius's size, he needs to be able to absorb a lot of contact.
quotes.quote: At Darius's size, he needs to be able to absorb a lot of contact and be able to make his way through the lane the way he plays. So having stability and strength through his core and his trunk is going to be really important for him at the next level.

quotes.speaker: Nick Potter
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Potter on Darius Acuff's need to guard bigger players
quotes.excerpt: At the next level, he is going to be required to guard bigger, faster players.
quotes.quote: At the next level, he is going to be required to guard bigger, faster players. And so, being able to be explosive and powerful through his hips and kind of stay in front of his defenders and create space on offense, some of this is kind of one of our main focuses for him.

quotes.speaker: Virgil Phillips
quotes.summary_phrase: Virgil Phillips on Darius Acuff's early basketball development
quotes.excerpt: When I first met little Darius, six, seven years old, in this gym, he walks through the door.
quotes.quote: When I first met little Darius, six, seven years old, in this gym, he walks through the door, just stuck up, ready to play, fist balled up, looking around. What is with he? Man, he got energy, he want to get out there.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on wanting to team up with Derek Carr
quotes.excerpt: Probably Derek Carr. He probably can play defense. He is strong.
quotes.quote: Probably Derek Carr. He probably can play defense. He is strong.

quotes.speaker: Packie Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Packie Turner on Darius Acuff's ability to score in tight spaces
quotes.excerpt: He is going to get into the paint and it is going to be crowded, Darius.
quotes.quote: He is going to get into the paint and it is going to be crowded, Darius. And he has got to score in tight spaces, typically with the defender on his hip, to be able to bounce out of something or get all the way to the rim. So that is what we are working on right now.

quotes.speaker: Packie Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Packie Turner on Darius Acuff's draft preparation
quotes.excerpt: Being this close to his dream, it is not really hard to get him to come in.
quotes.quote: Being this close to his dream, it is not really hard to get him to come in here and keep after it.
